## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: license laws, license types and ID verification
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The identification charts list documents by tier, but the per-document point values did not come through in the extracted text, so no per-document point value is stated; only the combining rules are used [A07] (verify NJ-LIC-D-POINTS).
The REAL ID chart is a step diagram whose layout extracted out of order; facts were taken only where the step label and the document list were unambiguous [A09].
The license-type chart attaches numbered footnotes to cells; a footnote was used only where its marker was visibly attached to that cell, and the prorated upgrade-fee footnote is stated as a general chart note rather than tied to one license type [A05] (verify NJ-LIC-D-FOOTNOTE).
Fees, phone numbers and website addresses are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic; the manual itself says fees are subject to change.
Statute citations printed after each law were summarized, not copied.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: The point value of each identity document on the Standard and REAL ID charts (physical pages 12 to 15) was not legible in the extracted text; confirm the values from the MVC 6-point ID page or the rendered chart before any point value is taught.
The license chart footnote on a one-year return for an upgrade with a prorated fee (physical page 10) has no visible marker in the extracted text; confirm which license type it applies to.
